description: Re-resolves which brand truths a brief's page will be written from, and stores the result on the brief. Synchronous — returns in a few seconds; no operation to poll. A brief stores the brand truths (facts, audience truths, negative space) chosen for that page, each with a short reason. Use this after editing brand truths, or when the stored set looks wrong or stale. Manual additions/removals made with seo_edit_brief `truthIds` are replaced by the fresh selection. Response: { truths: [{truthId, slug, name, reason, contentHash, snapshot, status}], truthConflicts: [{truthIds, note}], resolvedAt }. status `current` = unchanged; `changed` = the truth was edited since the brief was resolved (regenerate the page to pick it up); `deleted` = the truth no longer exists.
name: seo_resolve_brief_truths
